label: Leaver Ban
description: Automatic timed bans for players who repeatedly leave matches early. Owns the leaves/games_left/games_completed tracking keys and the qlx_leaverBan* cvars (separate from manual bans in ban.py).

commands.name: forgive
commands.description: Removes leaves from a player, starting with the oldest (optionally a specific count).

commands.name: gamestats
commands.description: Returns a player's game leave/completion statistics.

commands.name: tracked
commands.description: Lists all players currently being tracked for leaver bans.

commands.name: checkleaver
commands.description: Checks a player's leaver-ban status: current leave count and, if banned, expiry/time remaining.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns leaver auto-ban tracking on or off.

cvars.label: Rolling Window (days)
cvars.description: Number of days over which leaves are counted before rolling off.

cvars.label: Max Leaves
cvars.description: Number of leaves within the rolling window before a ban is issued.

cvars.label: View-Others Permission
cvars.description: Minimum permission level required to check another player's leave stats.

cvars.label: Discord Webhook
cvars.description: Optional Discord webhook URL notified when a leaver ban is issued.
